title: International college
text: Educating The Next Global Innovators Welcome to BIC (Busan International College), where future generations are groomed into global innovators in Management, Technology, and Contents. Discover more BIC: A perfect place to experience Korea with a global perspective. BIC offers a global learning environment to unleash our students’ potential and pursue their purpose by experiencing Korea’s diverse Korean culture firsthand. Discover more ACT: Active learning to build Creativity and Thought leadership We strive to create an active learning environment in which all students can thrive and reach their full potential. Discover more Global Innovation College Our Vision & Mission. Educating The Next Global Innovators Through our forward-thinking learning environment, we empower young innovators to make a positive difference in the world.
